# A derived property evaluates its value expression over the columns of each element's row.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-schema-statements.md
# The rows are the existing Person, Account and Knows fixture.
GRAPH scalar_graph.ComputedProperties
MATCH (p:Person)
RETURN p.code, p.upper_name
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(CONCAT(CAST(code AS STRING), ':', upper_name), ',' ORDER BY code) AS result
=> "1001:ALEX,1002:DANA,1003:LEE"
GRAPH scalar_graph.ComputedProperties
MATCH (n)
RETURN n.kind
NEXT
RETURN STRING_AGG(kind, ',' ORDER BY kind) AS result
=> "checking!,person,person,person"
SELECT STRING_AGG(name, ',' ORDER BY name) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.ComputedProperties MATCH (p:Person WHERE p.code > 1001) RETURN p.upper_name AS name)
=> "DANA,LEE"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.ComputedProperties MATCH (p:Person {code: 1003}) RETURN p.id AS result)
=> "3"

# A value expression's result can be NULL, such as for the self-loop 12 here.
SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(delta AS STRING), ',' ORDER BY delta) FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.ComputedProperties MATCH -[e:Knows]-> RETURN e.delta AS delta)
=> "-1,1,1"
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.ComputedProperties MATCH -[e:Knows WHERE e.id = 12]-> RETURN e.delta AS result)
=> null
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.ComputedProperties MATCH (a:Person)-[e:Knows]->(b:Person) WHERE e.delta = b.id - a.id RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> "3"
